title: aquilegia vicaria subsp. tianschanica
intro: Aquilegia vicaria subsp. tianschanica, commonly known as the Tianshan Columbine, is a plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia vicaria subsp. tianschanica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
